title.original: MCPToolBench++: A Large Scale AI Agent Model Context Protocol MCP Tool Use Benchmark
title.zh: MCPToolBench++：大规模AI 智能体模型上下文协议MCP工具使用基准
title.en: MCPToolBench++: A Large Scale AI Agent Model Context Protocol MCP Tool Use Benchmark

inclusion_reason.zh: MCPToolBench++ 的市场采集、模式归一化和多步调用 Runner 提供跨领域 MCP 能力评测所需的数据与执行底座。
inclusion_reason.en: MCPToolBench++ supplies marketplace ingestion, schema normalization, and a multi-step runner as data and execution infrastructure for cross-domain MCP evaluation.

abstract.zh: MCPToolBench++ 从大型 MCP 市场构建跨领域、单步与多步工具调用数据，用于评估 Agent 处理异构 Server 响应和有限上下文的能力。
abstract.en: MCPToolBench++ builds multi-domain single- and multi-step tool-use data from a large MCP marketplace to assess heterogeneous server responses and constrained tool context.

problem.zh: MCP 工具缺少覆盖广的统一评测，Server 返回格式和可用性差异很大，海量工具描述又会迅速占满模型上下文。
problem.en: MCP lacks broad unified evaluation; server response formats and reliability vary, and descriptions for thousands of tools quickly exhaust model context.

approach.zh: 作者聚合数千个 Server 和多类工具，整理不同领域的单步/多步调用任务，并在同一数据协议下运行具 Agent 能力的模型。
approach.en: Thousands of servers and tool categories are aggregated into single- and multi-step tasks under a common data protocol for evaluating agentic models.

system_design.zh: 数据管线抓取 MCP 市场与 GitHub，规范化 Server/工具模式和响应，生成调用链样本，再由统一 Runner 执行与计分。
system_design.en: A data pipeline crawls MCP markets and GitHub, normalizes server/tool schemas and responses, generates call-chain examples, and evaluates them through a common runner.

key_results.zh: 论文给出多种先进模型在大规模 MCP 调用上的对照结果，并揭示真实工具成功率和上下文容量使该任务不同于传统函数调用。
key_results.en: The paper benchmarks advanced models at large-scale MCP use and shows that real tool reliability and context limits make it distinct from conventional function calling.

limitations.zh: 市场条目包含失效或低质量 Server，摘要未说明完整的可运行验证和安全隔离；数据快照也会随 MCP 生态快速过时。
limitations.en: Marketplace entries include broken or low-quality servers, executable validation and isolation are not fully established, and the snapshot will age quickly with the ecosystem.

metrics.name: MCP servers represented by the source marketplace

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
